<!-- RFC process: https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvflow/blob/main/docs/rfcs/README.md -->

**Motivation**
What problem does this solve, and for whom?

**Proposed change**
What should change? Include interfaces, configuration, or workflow examples where they help.

**Alternatives considered**
What else did you consider, and why is this proposal better?

**Feedback period**
At least one week. Until when should this stay open for comments?

**CC**
Who should review this?
